verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for terminal emulators, since some terminals ship integrated AI features, so the story applies to WezTerm. The evidence pack covers SSH, multiplexing, the CLI, scrollback, Quick Select and Lua config, but nothing describes any built-in AI assistant or task delegation. The headless CLI control loop lets external tools drive WezTerm, but that is not a built-in assistant and is not credited here.
